chapter.title: Chapter Twelve: Regular Guy Behavior
chapter.subtitle: Publicity arrives wearing somebody else's jersey.
chapter.description: A painfully normal celebrity campaign draws attention, noise complaints, and one exact Regular guy named LeBron James.

tips: Listen for the terms before the first contest.

scenes.speaker: Promoter
scenes.text: We need public proof this roof serves people. I booked a regular neighborhood testimonial.

scenes.speaker: Regular guy named LeBron James
scenes.text: Hey. I am LeBron James. Not the basketball player. Regular guy. Appliance repair.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: Your business card says LeBRON JAMES in forty-point type and appliance repair in dust.

scenes.speaker: Regular guy named LeBron James
scenes.text: Brand recognition is not a crime.

scenes.speaker: Regular guy named LeBron James
scenes.text: A washing-machine lid, yes. A basketball, medically no.

scenes.speaker: Snitch
scenes.text: The famous-name misunderstanding has tripled viewers and summoned two news vans.

scenes.speaker: Baby Momma
scenes.text: Then point every camera away from children and toward the repair log.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: And somebody unplug Blue's smoke cannons.

tips: Its result settles only the stated event term.

starObjectives.description: Move at least one of your cards.

preDialogue.speaker: Regular guy named LeBron James
preDialogue.text: Winner gets the testimonial slot. Loser helps me carry a dryer belt display.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: Is the display heavy?

preDialogue.speaker: Regular guy named LeBron James
preDialogue.text: Emotionally. Nobody respects belts until the drum stops.

preDialogue.speaker: Promoter
preDialogue.text: His card says appliance repair. If the news crops that out, I’m standing in front of the lens.

preDialogue.speaker: Regular guy named LeBron James
preDialogue.text: I fix appliances. That’s the whole bio. The name is a paperwork accident.

preDialogue.speaker: Snitch
preDialogue.text: Paperwork accident currently trending. My mentions on fire.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: Regular guy named LeBron James. Name tag and museum plaque already drafted.

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: He came to fix a fridge. Not to be content. Let the man work.

preDialogue.speaker: Regular guy named LeBron James
preDialogue.text: Fridge first. Autographs never. I got a wrench and a boundary.

preDialogue.speaker: Snitch
preDialogue.text: Boundary noted. Still getting the B-roll of the wrench though.

postDialogue.speaker: Regular guy named LeBron James
postDialogue.text: You get the slot. I still request one sentence about lint safety.

postDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
postDialogue.text: You get six words.

postDialogue.speaker: Regular guy named LeBron James
postDialogue.text: Clean your lint trap, beloved community.

postDialogue.speaker: Regular guy named LeBron James
postDialogue.text: Fridge cold. Invoice fair. I’m gone before the next caption.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Invoice filed under “regular excellence.” Plaque still pending.

postDialogue.speaker: Snitch
postDialogue.text: Mentions cooling off. For now.

postDialogue.speaker: Wifey
postDialogue.text: Good. Keep the man out the algorithm.

starObjectives.description: Move at least one of your cards.

tips: Its result settles only the stated event term.

preDialogue.speaker: Live Streamer
preDialogue.text: My viewers want a rooftop feud, not a compliance binder.

preDialogue.speaker: Snitch
preDialogue.text: Then compete for the first interview and live with the answer.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
preDialogue.text: Center lane closes while the news van blocks the stairs.

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: If that van crushes my repair cones, your channel buys new ones.

preDialogue.speaker: Snitch
preDialogue.text: News van outside. They think we got a celebrity appliance guy.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
preDialogue.text: We got a regular guy and a working fridge. That’s the whole story.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: I’m prepared to brief them on torque and boundaries.

preDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
preDialogue.text: Nobody brief nothing about the child or the private schedule.

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: Win this and the van leave with the fridge story only. Lose and they invent the rest.

postDialogue.speaker: Live Streamer
postDialogue.text: Fine. First interview is the player and the repair crew.

postDialogue.speaker: Snitch
postDialogue.text: My feed caught the van rolling over RichRoof flyers instead.

postDialogue.speaker: Wifey
postDialogue.text: Leave them there until the camera gets the date.

postDialogue.speaker: Snitch
postDialogue.text: Van left with “local repair hero” and zero family footage. Acceptable.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Hero of torque. I’m updating the plaque draft.

postDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
postDialogue.text: Update nothing that got a face on it. Text only.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
postDialogue.text: Text only. Agreed. Next topic.

tips: Its result settles only the stated event term.

phases.name: Public Pressure
phases.description: At round three, the opponent gains 1 Motion.

phases.name: Late Arrival
phases.description: At round 6, the opponent draws one card from its remaining ten-card deck. If the deck is empty, no card is added.

passive.name: Announced Terms
passive.description: The final table escalates once without changing the agreement outside the match.

preDialogue.speaker: Officer Oink
preDialogue.text: Complaint says amplified yelling, obstructed stairs, and one fraudulent athlete.

preDialogue.speaker: Regular guy named LeBron James
preDialogue.text: I have been this LeBron James since birth. Take it up with my mother.

preDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
preDialogue.text: The announced table settles whether the event ends now or at the permitted hour.

preDialogue.speaker: Officer Oink
preDialogue.text: Until the permitted hour if you win. Either way, that van moves. It’s been blinking at me for twenty minutes.

preDialogue.speaker: Officer Oink
preDialogue.text: Noise complaint from three doors down. Somebody streaming power tools at midnight.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
preDialogue.text: That was one time. And the rail needed it.

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: The rail needed silence and daylight. You needed an audience.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: I’m entering “one time” into the evidence log with a side-eye emoji.

preDialogue.speaker: Officer Oink
preDialogue.text: Win the table and the complaint stay a warning. Lose and I write the citation.

postDialogue.speaker: Officer Oink
postDialogue.text: Event continues until the permitted hour. Clear the stair landing.

postDialogue.speaker: Regular guy named LeBron James
postDialogue.text: I will move the belt display. It has caused enough division.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: History will remember where it stood. I drew chalk around it.

postDialogue.speaker: Officer Oink
postDialogue.text: Warning only. Next midnight stream and the citation write itself.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
postDialogue.text: No more midnight streams. Daylight and quiet. I got it.

postDialogue.speaker: Wifey
postDialogue.text: Repeat it when the camera off.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Camera off logged. Quiet pending. Archive satisfied.

tips: The match result and the real-world agreement remain separate.

scenes.speaker: Promoter
scenes.text: The segment aired: repairs, open play, family programming, no fake ownership claims.

scenes.speaker: Snitch
scenes.text: Also seven seconds of Cornball saluting a dryer belt.

scenes.speaker: Regular guy named LeBron James
scenes.text: My shop got nineteen calls. Eighteen asked if I could fix a jump shot.

scenes.speaker: Regular guy named LeBron James
scenes.text: I can replace a squeaky bearing. Start there.

scenes.speaker: Baby Momma
scenes.text: Publicity bought attention. Now attention needs a record longer than one news cycle.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Red
scenes.text: An exhibit: photos, schedules, repairs, and statements from people who use the space.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: A museum nobody can keep clean. Perfect.
